V0.name: TITLE_ONLY
V0.description: Only the title and identifier were seen. Nothing about method or results is verified.

V1.name: SEARCH_SUMMARY
V1.description: Metadata and claims come from a web-search result summary, not from the paper itself.

V2.name: ABSTRACT_READ
V2.description: The abstract was read on the primary source.

V3.name: FULL_TEXT_READ
V3.description: The full text was read; methods, numbers and limitations are taken from the paper.

V4.name: INDEPENDENTLY_CHECKED
V4.description: Claims were checked against a second source, code, or a reproduction.

strength_rules.CONFIRMED: requires at least one V3+ source and no contradicting evidence
strength_rules.SUPPORTED: requires >=2 independent sources or one V3 source
strength_rules.EXPERIMENTAL: single source, any level, with a described mechanism
